snippet.title: Shotgun Farmers - Supporter Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce the launch of our first-ever Supporter Pack! This special pack is designed for our dedicated community members who want to show extra support for the game's development.

Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/991920/Shotgun_Farmers_Supporter_Pack/
Get ir on Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP6313-CUSA25057_00-0771238053648352

What’s Included? 🎸🎤
• Cob 'n' Roll Shotgun Skin – Your shotgun transformed into an electric guitar.
• Rockin' Spade Shovel Skin – Drop beats with your microphone shovel.
• Bok Star Player Skins – Dress up in headliner-worthy outfits and own the stage.
• Legendary Hat & Eyewear – Complete the rockstar look with stylish accessories.
• Stageside Lobby – A brand-new lobby backdrop to set the tone before your next match.
• Exclusive Badges & Titles – Show off your support with exclusive rock-themed badges.
• Free Bok Lobby Music – Rock out in the lobby with this new track.
• Our eternal love and gratitude for your support ♥️

Thank you for being such an awesome community. Your support and feedback drive us to make Shotgun Farmers the best it can be.

See you on the farm!

-Qazi

Play Shotgun Farmers:

🎮 PS4: https://shotgunfarmers.com/ps4
🎮 Xbox One: http://bit.ly/shotgunfarmersxbox
🎮 Steam: http://bit.ly/shotgunfarmers
🎮 Switch: https://shotgunfarmers.com/switch

Shotgun Farmers is the first-person multiplayer shooter where missed shots grow guns. Reloading isn’t an option, so grab one of the deadly crops planted by earlier missed shots. Shot at by a sniper? Well they just planted you your very own sniper gun to fire back with! Harvest weapon plants quickly for more ammo or let them grow for a larger clip. 

Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/shotgunfarmers
